title: Studying psychology at the University of Chicago
summary: She enrolled briefly in the 1940s, studying with a boyfriend, just to be knowledgeable.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: One piece of information that I’ve come across in some of the writings about that I’m very unclear about says that you studied Psychology at the University of Chicago in the 1940’s, yes or no?
I had a boyfriend that was going there so me and him would study together. And I’d help him with some of his problems.
How did studying Psychology at the University of Chicago differ from studying Sociology at USC?
It’s all the same. Every story got three different sections. And instruction is still instruction.
Did you have any professional goals in the field of psychology?
Not particularly. I just wanted to be knowledgeable. When people say “Van Gogh” or “The Rorschach Test,” I wanted to know what they were talking about.
How long did you study at the University of Chicago?
